the majority of neutron star - helium star binaries evolve into the pulsar "cemetery," and only a minority are strongly recycled.

the progenitor of a relativistic binary pulsar is a neutron star - helium star binary, that the helium star can spin up its neutron star companion via accretive processes, and that such evolutionary scenarios lead to the formation of a large number of "gravestone" systems.
